calibration.rule: w = (observed + a) / (expected + a) per outcome; used only with ≥ minResolved resolved rulings and a lower leave-one-out log loss than the uncalibrated distribution

errorToHit.question: P(play scored as reached-on-error is officially changed to a hit)
errorToHit.selectionRule: simplest model within one standard error (paired per-play log-loss differences vs the best candidate) under 10-fold cross-validation grouped by game

errorKind.note: Early evidence only: the original error type of a play changed to a hit is not in StatsAPI any more (verified), and the official log names it for only part of the changes. The ratio compares the share of each type among changes whose log wording states it with the share among errors that stood — it assumes the wording does not depend on the type. Not used in scores; the live capture measures it properly.

adjust.question: Adjustment to the error → hit model learned from rulings captured live before any change (error type included)

hitToError.question: P(play scored as a hit, not a home run, is officially changed to an error)
hitToError.selectionRule: simplest model within one standard error (paired per-play log-loss differences vs the best candidate) under 10-fold cross-validation grouped by game

training.note: Labels come from the official post-game scoring-change log. In-game changes are not in the log; the live site observes those directly.

sources.name: MLB Official Scoring Changes 2024 (Internet Archive capture 2025-01-21T08:35:45Z)

errorToHit.question: errorToHit
errorToHit.method: permutation test (group labels shuffled across plays) of Σ (observed − expected)² / variance, expected from out-of-fold model probabilities; plus a cross-validated candidate model with one term per group (≥ 40 plays)

hitToError.question: hitToError
hitToError.method: permutation test (group labels shuffled across plays) of Σ (observed − expected)² / variance, expected from out-of-fold model probabilities; plus a cross-validated candidate model with one term per group (≥ 40 plays)

capture.source: data/capture/rulings-YYYY-MM.json — pipeline/capture.mjs polls MLB StatsAPI playByPlay during live games (GitHub Actions, every 10 minutes during game hours)
capture.whyNeeded: StatsAPI rewrites history: timecode snapshots and diffPatch show the current ruling even for moments before a change (verified on 2026 official log #3 and #6), so an original call can only be known if it was recorded before it changed.
